q: How do I backflush the group heads?

chunks.text: Insert the blind basket, add 3 g (about half a teaspoon) of espresso machine cleaner, and run the pump 10 seconds on and 10 seconds off, five times. Then repeat five times with plain water only.
chunks.heading: Backflush the group heads

chunks.text: Run the group head for 3 seconds to flush it.
chunks.heading: Purge

chunks.text: If the low-water light comes on, stop making espresso and tell the shift lead. Do not run the machine empty. If a group head leaks, stop using it and tell the shift lead.
chunks.heading: Low water or leaks
chunks.title: Espresso Bar - Shot and Milk Standards

chunks.text: Soak portafilters and baskets in cleaner solution for 20 minutes, then rinse well.

chunks.text: Empty and wash the knock box and the drip tray.

q: What temperature do I steam almond milk to?

chunks.text:
| Milk | Target temperature |
|---|---|
| Whole and 2 percent | 150 to 155°F (65 to 68°C) |
| Soy | 140 to 150°F (60 to 65°C) |
| Oat | 140 to 150°F (60 to 65°C) |
| Almond | 130 to 140°F (54 to 60°C) |

Never exceed 160°F (71°C). If milk goes above 160°F, discard it and start over.
chunks.heading: Target temperatures
chunks.title: Espresso Bar - Shot and Milk Standards

chunks.text: Steam the milk to its target temperature (see SOP-220), stretching for 2 to 4 seconds.
chunks.heading: Latte: steam milk
chunks.title: Drink Recipes

chunks.text: Steam the milk to its target temperature, stretching for 6 to 8 seconds to build thick foam.
chunks.heading: Cappuccino: steam milk
chunks.title: Drink Recipes

chunks.text: Steam the milk to its target temperature, stretching for only 1 to 2 seconds.
chunks.heading: Flat white: steam milk
chunks.title: Drink Recipes

chunks.text: Steam the milk to its target temperature, pour it in, and top with whipped cream if the guest wants it.
chunks.heading: Mocha: steam and pour
chunks.title: Drink Recipes

chunks.text: Submerge the tip deeper to spin a whirlpool until the milk reaches its target temperature, which is when the pitcher is too hot to hold for more than 2 to 3 seconds.
chunks.heading: Spin
chunks.title: Espresso Bar - Shot and Milk Standards
